card.text: Small, possibly double-lobed moon of Pluto coated in clean water ice.

introduction.text: Mark Showalter's team found Kerberos with Hubble in 2011. New Horizons showed it is smaller and brighter than expected.

model.title: Approximate shape model
model.summary: A New Horizons shape estimate; a two-lobed form is still possible, and the pole is uncertain.
